CVE-2019-19450.title: paraparser in ReportLab before 3.5.31 allows remote code executio ...
CVE-2019-19450.description: paraparser in ReportLab before 3.5.31 allows remote code execution because start_unichar in paraparser.py evaluates untrusted user input in a unichar element in a crafted XML document with '<unichar code="' followed by arbitrary Python code, a similar issue to CVE-2019-17626.
